name: Das Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Das Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in intelligent metering solutions and comprehensive home automation systems. Their extensive product line for smart homes includes a variety of devices such as central gateways, wireless thermostats, and power receptacles, along with smart lighting dimmers and user interface touch pads. They also provide automated electric curtains and a robust suite of safety and security products, encompassing wireless gas and smoke detectors, video intercoms, cameras, infrared remote controls, security machines, and contact alarms. A notable offering is the EZSwitch, designed to integrate various household appliances and electronic gadgets into a Wi-Fi network. Beyond hardware, Das Technology develops specialized software. This includes LSP, which assists users in migrating Windows NT operating systems to Linux, and LMAIL, a dedicated webmail application for Linux environments. The company also offers MVReader, a utility for acquiring meter data via an RS232 port and transmitting it to control centers through GPRS, in addition to standard power plugs. Established in 1999, Das Technology Co., Ltd. operates from its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
